questions.stem: A 22-Year-old primigravida female was due for her date and started having labor pain at 8 am. On examination, PV findings revealed – cervical dilatation - 6 cm, 70% effaced, membranes intact. 2 hours after full cervical dilatation, the fetus is not delivered. She is exhausted, and on PV, caput formation can be felt. What is the appropriate step in the management of this patient?

options.label: C
options.text: Normal vaginal delivery with the help of vacuum extraction
